description: This file implements a Kubernetes controller for aggregating cluster roles based on label selectors, managing updates via server-side apply or direct update, and handling events to maintain cluster role rules consistency.

classes.name: ClusterRoleAggregationController
classes.description: Controller for aggregating cluster roles based on label selectors and rules.

methods.name: NewClusterRoleAggregation
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the ClusterRoleAggregationController, setting up event handlers.

methods.name: syncClusterRole
methods.description: Synchronizes a cluster role by aggregating rules from selected cluster roles based on label selectors.

methods.name: applyClusterRoles
methods.description: Applies new cluster role rules using server-side apply.

methods.name: updateClusterRoles
methods.description: Updates cluster role rules directly if server-side apply is unsupported.

methods.name: toApplyPolicyRules
methods.description: Converts a list of PolicyRules to apply configuration format.

methods.name: toApplyPolicyRule
methods.description: Converts a single PolicyRule to apply configuration format.

methods.name: ruleExists
methods.description: Checks if a PolicyRule exists within a list.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the controller, managing worker routines and event processing.

methods.name: runWorker
methods.description: Processes work items from the queue.

methods.name: processNextWorkItem
methods.description: Processes the next item in the work queue, handling errors and retries.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Enqueues cluster roles that have aggregation rules for processing.
